source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of selection sort (PDF 84).

blocks.text: Selection Sort ek aur saada sorting algorithm hai. Yeh list ke unsorted (be-tarteeb) hisse se sab se chhota element (ya sab se bara, jaisi tarteeb chahiye) chunta (select karta) hai aur use unsorted hisse ke pehle element se swap kar deta hai. Yahi process list ke baqi unsorted hisse par dohraya jata hai.

items: List ke unsorted hisse mein sab se chhota (minimum) element dhoondein.
Use pehle unsorted element se swap karein.
Sorted aur unsorted hisson ki boundary (dono hisson ke beech ki line) ek element aage kar dein.
Baqi elements ke liye yahi process dohrayein.

blocks.text: Misal: list [29,10,14,37,13] mein Selection Sort pehle sab se chhota element 10 dhoondega aur use 29 se swap karega. List [10,29,14,37,13] ban jayegi. Yeh process list poori sort hone tak chalta hai.

blocks.caption: [29, 10, 14, 37, 13] par Selection Sort (pehla qadam kitab ka, baqi hamare hal kiye hue)

blocks.text: Yeh program Selection Sort ka har qadam print karta hai, jaise upar wali table mein. numbers list badal kar Run karein aur dekhein har qadam par kaunsa minimum chuna jata hai.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"numbers = [29, 10, 14, 37, 13]": sort karne wali list; "items = list(numbers)" us ki copy.
"for i in range(len(items) - 1):": har qadam par position i par sahi number rakhna hai.
"smallest = i" aur andar wala loop: unsorted hisse (i se aage) mein sab se chhote number ki position dhoondta hai.
"if smallest != i:": minimum kahin aur mila to swap wali line dono ki jagah badal deti hai aur "swap" wala qadam print hota hai.
"else:": minimum pehle se sahi jagah par ho to "already in place" print hota hai.
Note: print swap ke baad hota hai, is liye "swap 10 and 29" mein pehla number naya (chhota) aur doosra purana hai.
Output: "Step 1 : swap 10 and 29 -> [10, 29, 14, 37, 13]", "Step 2 : swap 13 and 29 -> [10, 13, 14, 37, 29]", "Step 3 : 14 already in place -> ...", "Step 4 : swap 29 and 37 -> [10, 13, 14, 29, 37]", phir "Sorted: [10, 13, 14, 29, 37]".
Khud try karein: numbers = [5, 4, 3, 2, 1] kar ke Run karein: sirf do swap lagte hain aur Step 3, 4 "already in place" hote hain.
Complexity: Selection Sort ki time complexity O(n²) hai. Bubble Sort ki tarah yeh bare datasets ke liye efficient nahi, magar banana seedha aur aasan hai.

blocks.prompt: [29, 10, 14, 37, 13] par Selection Sort kitne swap karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Teen swap (qadam 1, 2 aur 4); qadam 3 mein 14 pehle se apni jagah par hai.

items: Selection Sort: unsorted hisse ka minimum chuno, aage swap karo; O(n²).
